items.t: NTA UGC-NET December 2026 — Computer Science Exam Schedule Out
items.x: NTA released the UGC-NET December 2026 subject-wise CBT schedule on November 19, 2026. Examinations run on December 14, 15, 16, 17, 18, and 21, 2026 in two shifts (9:00 AM–12:00 PM and 3:00 PM–6:00 PM). Computer Science and Applications is scheduled for December 14, 2026. Advance city intimation slips are issued prior to the exam.

items.t: BPSC TRE 4.0 — Computer Science Teacher (Class 11–12) Exam Calendar
items.x: Bihar Public Service Commission (BPSC) notified 407 Computer Science Teacher vacancies for Classes 11–12 under TRE 4.0 (Advt. No. 15/2026). Eligible CS candidates include B.E./B.Tech (CS/IT), MCA, M.Sc. (CS), or BCA with PGDCA (with STET Paper-II). Monitor the official BPSC Exam Calendar (updated Nov 19, 2026) for exam and document verification dates.
items.q: B.E./B.Tech (CS/IT), MCA, M.Sc. (CS), or BCA with PGDCA (with STET Paper-II)

items.t: GATE 2027 (IIT Madras) — Application Rectification & Exam Schedule
items.x: Official GATE 2027 schedule announced by IIT Madras: Application rectification (scrutiny defects without fee) closes on November 30, 2026. City allotment notification will be released on January 4, 2027. GATE 2027 Examinations will be conducted on February 6, 7, 13, 14, 20, and 21, 2027, with results scheduled for March 19, 2027. Essential for M.Tech admissions and PSU CS recruitment.

items.t: ICPC Asia West Kanpur Multi-Site Regional Contest 2026
items.x: Following the ICPC India Preliminary Online Contest, the Kanpur Multi-Site Onsite Regional Contest will take place on December 22–23, 2026 across three centers: Kanpur, Gandhinagar, and Pune. Each team consists of 3 student contestants and 1 coach from the same institution.
